title: Seller Benefits of Pocketwire Personal Account Plans: Chargeback Reduction
content:
The owner of a Pocketwire Business Profile whose Pocketwire Personal Account is on a higher plan receives a personal plan chargeback reduction on each chargeback fee. The plan is the one shown on the owner's Pocketwire Personal Account record.

| Plan of the owner's Pocketwire Personal Account | Personal plan chargeback reduction |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit | USD 5.00 |
| Pocketwire Plus or Pocketwire Prime | USD 2.50 |
| any other plan | none |

**Formal statement.** The personal plan chargeback reduction is 5.00 dollars when the owner's personal account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit, 2.50 dollars when it is on Pocketwire Plus or Pocketwire Prime, and nothing on any other plan.

**Basis questions.** *An owner on Pocketwire Core?* No reduction. *An owner on Pocketwire Prime?* USD 2.50.
